sentences.en: A lot of children catch chicken pox in pre-school.

sentences.en: My three-year-old daughter has not had chicken pox but is also showing no symptoms.
sentences.vi: Con gái tôi ba tuổi không bị thủy đậu nhưng cũng không có triệu chứng gì.

sentences.en: They took tissue from everyone who received a small pox inoculation.

sentences.en: Outcomes Children identify some illnesses eg rubella, chicken pox and some conditions eg boils, tooth decay caused by microorganisms.

sentences.en: Would my son who has chicken pox be able to fly?

sentences.en: If you are pregnant and develop chicken pox or are in contact with someone who has it, you should consult the doctor.

sentences.en: Hence, it has been termed the ' French pox ' or the ' French disease ' [morbus gallicus] .

sentences.en: Usually the decision to vaccinate, except for fowl pox, should be made on the basis of area experience and expert advice.
